defense_news.title: Ukraine to be able to buy military supplies via NATO agency: report
defense_news.summary: The deal comes amid worsening U.S.-Ukraine relations since U.S. President Trump announced a diesel export deal with Russia this month to lower U.S. prices.

defense_news.title: US Air Force outlines the fighter fleet it needs by 2035
defense_news.summary: A new Air Force report calls for 1,509 combat-coded fighters by 2035, with F-35s making up 40% of the fleet and F-47s replacing F-22s.

defense_news.title: Pentagon AI oversight office struggles to keep pace with department’s ambitions, GAO finds
defense_news.summary: The Pentagon office tapped in 2022 to oversee the military’s responsible use of AI had filled just three of 10 authorized positions as of February 2026.

defense_news.title: Got milk? US Army refines its pasteurization power
defense_news.summary: Thirteen U.S. Army Veterinary Corps officers milked a trip to Denmark last month, completing Europe Dairy Pasteurization Audit Training.
